ctx.x: It was around this same time also that you were teaching at the Lenox School of Jazz.

This, too, was an outgrowth of the alliance with Gunther Schuller and John Lewis who were a part of a faction that brought about this thing at Lenox. They brought me into the fold on the level of teaching, and that’s how that all came about and how I first met your wonderful husband, David Baker. I had heard about David, but I think that was the first time we had encountered each other on a one-on-one basis.

That was one hell of a school. I was telling Lida and them that it was the prototype of what a school could be.
